title: The Caledonia and Professor Longhair
summary: The Caledonia was beautiful but rough; Longhair and Williams did separate shows there.

blocks.x: Oh, many times I played in the Caledonia.
What kind of place was that, nice, quiet place?

Caledonia? Uh-huh. Oh, it was beautiful, rough. Might get your head cut any time. You might be there. Go in there, hole, and come out half. Yeah? Yeah. Yeah, well during the time Professor Longhead was the start of, man. You remember old Professor Longhead? Sure. Sure. Professor of the mid that hit bald head, she ain't got no hair. All those kind of things, yeah.
Did you ever listen to him much?
Oh yeah, I listened to him at the first plenty of times. We used to work in the Caledonia together.
Uh-huh. Not at the same time.
Yeah, he'd do his show and I'd do my show.
Oh, I see, but not in the same band.
No, not in the same band, no.
